lockedDecisions.brand: Neon Arsenal. Remove SKINMARKET / SkinMarket / “CS2 Skin Marketplace”.

lockedDecisions.seller: Keep /seller/products and /seller/listings. Listings = unique-item CRUD. Products = read-only Product catalog via listProducts. Seller cannot create/update/delete Product (ADMIN-only API).
